body.x: Caliverse (CEO Dong-Kyu Kim) participated in “Seoul Tech Pavilion” in the main exhibition center (LVCC) of CES 2023 hosted in Las Vegas, U.S., for four days from Thursday, January 5 to Sunday, January 8 in local time.

Caliverse, a subsidiary of Lotte Data Communication, is a developer with ultra-high definition real film 3D VR production technology, realistic real-time rendering graphic production technology based on Unreal Engine, and interactive-related patent technology that reacts to the user's gaze or voice in virtual reality. It was recently incorporated into Lotte Group.

The business is capable of precise synthesizing of films (portraits) and graphics based on real-time rendering as well as highly realistic visual graphics. The firm also has network operation technology that enables large-scale simultaneous access or MMO (Massively Multiplayer Online).

With this technology and know-how under their belt, Caliverse is developing a metaverse with realistic graphics and an original interactive system. In its metaverse, friendly VR shopping hosts explain the information that users need in a virtual shopping center, and immersive experiences are offered in a virtual concert hall with an imaginary audience of over 65,000. Land, buildings, and avatars produced with NFTs will be available for sale, allowing users to create their own avatars and interior designs with editing tools, as well as enjoy various UGCs such as karaoke and DJing.

Caliverse’s metaverse (VR version demo and 3D TV) is available on VR devices with spectacular visuals developed by the Unreal Engine 5. Users can meet the staff through their avatars in a virtual space and experience the virtual shopping center, virtual stage featuring K-pop and DJ EM, and more.

According to a representative from Caliverse, "Existing metaverses are designed with a level of creative freedom integrated with games, setting a limit to shopping or entertainment performances. Therefore, we wanted to employ realistic and beautiful graphics to create a metaverse where the appearance of real people can coexist for a platform with more convenient shopping, inspiring entertainment, and an intuitive community. We are also aiming to create a more engaging virtual world that users can experience with VR devices and 3D TVs without 3D glasses.”

Having been recognized for its innovation by attracting investment from Japan within three months after its establishment in December 2017, Caliverse reached Number One in DMM weekly sales with its first work called “HANABI-Hana Type B,” a 119-minute-long interactive drama, while receiving attention with its launch in Sony PlayStation VR.

In South Korea, various virtual concerts and musicals have been produced under the commission of KT and LGU +, and the company’s VR promotional content created for Hyundai Motors, Kia, and Mercedes-Benz (Han Sung Motor) was well-received. Also, the business became the talk of the town when it produced a special stage package to mark the second anniversary of the debut of the famous K-Pop singer Daniel Kang.

CES, the world's largest IT fair, is an exhibition that provides a comprehensive view of the global consumer electronics industry in one place. It is held annually in Las Vegas in January by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News has annually reported on CES news for the world for 17 consecutive years since 2006, hosting the Best of CES which selects the best innovative products and technologies, and the Best of Made in Korea that chooses the most innovative businesses in South Korea. In addition, the media has delivered breaking news about CES through AIVING LIVE.

The Seoul Technology Pavilion operated a Theme Zone which implemented elements of visions for the future and elements for experiences, as well as a Tech Zone which displayed the innovative technology of partnered large corporations and startups. The Seoul Business Agency (SBA) showcased the Seoul Technology Pavilion’s innovative technology in the field of ‘mobility and ESG’ in a large corporation connected open innovation method, and 7 startups possessing innovative technology in the relevant fields will be in participation.
